world.moved: selected_action matches target AND NOT hidden_obstruction
world.terminal_receipt: moved bool and optional noisy obstacle hint; paid PROBE returns exact z; no cheap target, hidden z or obstruction truth

PROBE.information: paid exact z after admitted selection
PROBE.viability: probe available and hunger>2 and health>exposure and deadline>=3

learners.warmup: all arms PROBE if viable else CHEAP group MAP, retain probe exact or successful cheap as exact, ignore failed cheap
learners.causal_posterior: on moved=false, posterior P(z=chosen_z|observation) propto prior_mass(chosen_z) * p_obstruction * p(hint|obstruction), versus opposite_z likelihood P(hint) under independent obstruction; append fractional expected z label with weight1
learners.naive: on failed CHEAP infer opposite z, 1 full label
learners.success_only: only moved CHEAP supplies exact inferred z=chosen_z
learners.sensor_heuristic: if failed and observed hint=true ignore failure; if failed with hint=false or hint missing append opposite chosen z exact
learners.causal_no_sensor: same model with missing hint even if hint present
learners.probe_first: paid PROBE when viable, else CHEAP and learn only movement positive

scope: offline deterministic action attribution; decision correctness evaluator-only; movement observed but confounded; no actual Minecraft/LLM/GPU/power and no new semantic owner; no sibling Draft imports or merge
